name: rocketchat-connector
description: Rocket.Chat rooms, messages, threads and mentions as context for tasks and digests – optionally also for replying.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Rocket.Chat team chat via the REST API, using the user's own account. Read: the user's rooms with unread counters, messages and threads, full-text search across rooms, mentions, an unread overview for scheduled digests, directory and users. Write, in four groups that can each be switched off: send messages; reactions, read state and pinning; edit own messages; create and manage rooms. Deleting is not supported.

rocketchat_url.title: Rocket.Chat URL
rocketchat_url.description: Base URL of the Rocket.Chat server (without /api/v1), e.g. https://chat.example.org.

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: Shown when creating the personal access token (Rocket.Chat → Profile → Personal Access Tokens).

auth_token.title: Personal access token
auth_token.description: Rocket.Chat → Profile → Personal Access Tokens → add (enable "Ignore Two Factor Authentication"). The agent can see all rooms and direct messages of this account.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Offer no write tools (overrides the four switches below).

allow_send.title: Send messages
allow_send.description: Post to channels, groups, threads and direct messages – on behalf of the user.

allow_reactions.title: Reactions, read state, pinning
allow_reactions.description: Add emoji reactions, mark rooms as read, pin or star messages.

allow_edit.title: Edit own messages
allow_edit.description: Change the text of the user's own messages (no deleting).

allow_rooms.title: Create and manage rooms
allow_rooms.description: Create channels/groups, invite users, set topic/description/announcement.

default_limit.title: Default result count
default_limit.description: How many messages or rooms queries return by default (1–500).

max_body_chars.title: Max. characters per message
max_body_chars.description: Longer messages and attachments are truncated to save context.

tools.name: rocketchat_list_rooms
tools.description: List my rooms with unread counters

tools.name: rocketchat_get_room
tools.description: Get a room with topic, team and members

tools.name: rocketchat_get_messages
tools.description: Read messages of a room or thread

tools.name: rocketchat_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages in one or many rooms

tools.name: rocketchat_unread_overview
tools.description: Unread messages and mentions for digests

tools.name: rocketchat_list_mentions
tools.description: Mentions of the user across rooms

tools.name: rocketchat_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a room, thread or DM

tools.name: rocketchat_react
tools.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction

tools.name: rocketchat_create_room
tools.description: Create a channel or private group

prompts.name: rocketchat_daily_digest
prompts.text: Create a compact digest of my unread Rocket.Chat messages (focus: ${arguments.focus}). Use rocketchat_unread_overview and, where needed, rocketchat_get_messages. Structure: mentions and direct messages, decisions and news per room, the rest briefly. Do not mark anything as read and do not send anything.

prompts.name: rocketchat_room_summary
prompts.description: Summary of a room for a period
prompts.text: Summarize the Rocket.Chat room "${arguments.room}" since ${arguments.since} (rocketchat_get_room, rocketchat_get_messages, rocketchat_list_threads): topics, decisions, open tasks, links. Do not send anything.

prompts.name: rocketchat_my_mentions
prompts.description: Mentions that may need a response
prompts.text: List my Rocket.Chat mentions since ${arguments.since} (rocketchat_list_mentions), check for threads whether I replied, and put unanswered questions first. Do not send anything.
